scan_summary.data_access_pattern: Entity Framework 6 with LINQ (no inline SQL)
scan_summary.reason_no_statements: This application exclusively uses Entity Framework 6 LINQ for all data access operations. The EF provider (EntityFramework6.Npgsql) generates PostgreSQL-compatible SQL at runtime from LINQ expressions. No static SQL strings exist in the codebase. Comprehensive scan of all 39 files (22 .cs, 13 .cshtml, 4 config files) confirmed zero inline SQL statements. Therefore, no SQL statement pairs exist to validate for equivalency.
